pairs.why: A's saucer fills more of the card width and height, close to the edges like the large real heroes, while B's pale saucer is smaller with more empty yellow around it.
A's locker is larger and runs nearly the full card height, like the real locker, while B's is smaller and thinner with more empty wall.
A's pump and sign fill more of the card height and read bigger, which is closer to the real card's large hero. B is slightly smaller and loose in the desert.
Both clocks are centered and about the same size, a little larger than the real one, so framing gives no reason to choose.
B's gloves are bigger and crowd the right and bottom edges like the real cropped, fill-the-card gloves, while A's are small and low with a lot of empty floor.
Both put a centered sphere on a stand at a similar size and with similar margins, so framing doesn't separate them.
A's lamp is large and the truss is cropped by the top edge, as on the real card. B's lamp and truss are small and float in a lot of empty space.
A's chair is big, centered and fills most of the card like the real chair, while B's is thin and small with a large empty floor.
